biology: In parts of Fujian it is a major pest of reservoirs.
soldier: Soldier head yellow or deep yellow, slightly paler in the middle of the anterior part, the labrum yellow, the antennae yellowish brown with the terminal segments darker, the mandibles black at the apex and yellowish brown at the base, the thorax, legs and abdomen pale yellow, the pronotum slightly darker. Head oval and flat, the anterior end distinctly contracted and gradually forming an inclined surface, longer than wide, widest at the middle, the posterior margin arcuate, the fontanelle indistinct. Labrum lingulate, longer than wide, widest at the base, with several bristles arranged on each side. Mandibles slender and sabre-like, the apices slightly curved, slightly shorter than the head length; a large tooth on the inner margin of the left mandible at the anterior quarter and a small tooth near the base; the right mandible has an undeveloped small tooth on the inner margin near the apical quarter and another small tooth near the base. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 1 cylindrical and the longest, segment 2 slightly shorter, segment 3 square and the shortest, segments 4 to 11 gradually enlarging and clavate, the terminal segment the largest and oval. Pronotum saddle-shaped, narrower than the head width, the anterior margin projecting forwards in a leaf-like lobe with a median notch, the posterior margin contracted at the sides and slightly depressed at the middle.
